Yummy Baked Cod
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:21am

Ingredients




2" cod
1/4 cup chives
1/2 cup Miracle Whip (no substitute)
1 egg white, beaten stiff
Parmesan cheese
Parsley

Preparation

1 Mix Miracle Whip and chives. Add 2/3 to 3/4 of the egg white. Place fish in buttered pan. Spread mixture over fish. Sprinkle with Parmesan and parsley. Bake for 5 minutes at 450 degrees. Then broil until brown.
